summary: A MIDI controller firmware: the keys, knobs, an arpeggiator and a Euclidean drum sequencer send MIDI over USB and Bluetooth, and the FM-1 also plays it all on its own General MIDI sounds.
features: Velocity and aftertouch read from the keys
Scale mode with the scale's chords on the black keys
Four banks of assignable knob CCs
Arpeggiator and a four-track Euclidean drum sequencer
USB and Bluetooth MIDI out; TRS MIDI in is passed along
A separate USB-only build without Bluetooth; Screen Reader support
